name: Acne Studios
demographics: The Desert Hills Premium Outlets area in Cabazon attracts affluent tourists and locals from the Greater Los Angeles and Palm Springs regions, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-income households seeking luxury brands at outlet prices. The trade area draws heavily from Asian-American and Hispanic demographics, along with international tourists, particularly during peak shopping seasons. Shoppers are predominantly aged 25-54, often traveling in family groups or as couples, with a strong preference for designer and premium fashion brands at discounted prices.
description: Acne Studios at Desert Hills Premium Outlets in Cabazon represents the Swedish luxury fashion house's commitment to bringing contemporary design to one of Southern California's premier outlet shopping destinations. Located at 48650 Seminole Drive in the heart of the Coachella Valley, this location offers discerning shoppers access to Acne Studios' distinctive minimalist aesthetic and high-quality ready-to-wear collections for both women and men. The store features the brand's signature denim, leather goods, scarves, and seasonal collections, all presented in the clean, modern retail environment that Acne Studios is known for worldwide. Open daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, the boutique provides a full-service shopping experience with knowledgeable staff ready to assist customers in finding the perfect pieces from current and sale collections. As part of the larger Desert Hills Premium Outlets complex, shoppers can combine their visit to Acne Studios with access to over 180 other luxury and premium brand outlets, making it a must-visit destination for fashion enthusiasts traveling between Los Angeles and Palm Springs.
summary: Acne Studios at Desert Hills Premium Outlets in Cabazon offers Swedish luxury fashion with a minimalist aesthetic, featuring contemporary ready-to-wear collections, signature denim, and accessories for women and men. Located in one of Southern California's premier outlet destinations, the store provides access to high-end designer fashion at outlet pricing in a modern retail environment.
